description: Strategies available to copy, with the SAME numbers a human sees, as a DAILY snapshot (UTC: the same object all day): time-weighted return net of fees (immune to the leader's deposits and withdrawals — never a return on capital), max drawdown, Sharpe, trade count and the leader's terms. Read max_drawdown_pct before ranking by return — the best return is often the one that hurt most.
name: list_copy_leaders
